original.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io, each spec.provider.fake.data[] item must now include value (the items' required list changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"]), so ClusterSecretStore objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: [ev-9fd85560a485] shows that between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0 the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"] in the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io v1beta1 schema. So the crd-field subject (group external-secrets.io, kind ClusterSecretStore, version v1beta1, path spec.provider.fake.data[].value) and the change type now-required are both right. The field exists in both releases' CRD bundles [ev-9889c9b8706d, ev-e08924afdc47], so it was made mandatory rather than added, and the deterministic validators confirmed this. This matches known fact vf-30c8400eac07.
